You: I was scared. My ex is someone who can’t be trusted…
You: There’s no way of telling what kind of lies she told my mom about me.
Blaubleim: It’s hard to tell if your fears are well founded, because I never met your former girlfriend, but you must understand that this is your mother we are talking about.
Blaubleim: Have some more faith in her.
You: …
